title: Patch rules
description: What the apply-patch script is to admit from a producer's patch: one row per prepare mode a patch-producing skill uses, `default` for one with no prepare mode, and `issue` for a patch that goes to a new issue-lane branch. Contract: docs/conventions/pr-pipeline/README.md, Patch rules.

refuse.description: Named kept paths; apply-patch withholds a match from a [head] push and posts it as a proposed diff, and a merge row refuses it. github-workflows: .github/workflows/** in any case and through any .. segment; settings: **/settings*.json; symlink: mode 120000; gitlink: mode 160000; rename-into-refused: a rename whose new path another refusal matches.

allow.description: What a path the refusals pass must also meet. any: nothing more; kept-threads: the path of a thread the run kept; dependency-manifests: an npm or pip manifest or lock file outside .github/; merge-result: a path the base merge left conflicted, which the patch must leave with no conflict markers; the merge's own changes from the base side pass through without facing the rules.

max-files.description: The most paths one patch may change; null for no limit. Under a merge row it counts only the patch's own changes, measured from the conflict tree, never the base side's.

max-blobs.description: Merge rows: the most blobs one merge commit may upload, counting each blob that neither the head nor the base holds at its path; over it, nothing is written.

requires.description: What the producer's output must say before any path is applied.

parents.description: The commit's parents: the producer's head, then the trusted base tip for a merge.

message.description: The subject, with {ref}, {base}, {lane}, {activity} and {issue} filled in by apply-patch.

trailer.description: The trailer line that names the activity, with {lane} and {activity} filled in.

reads-report.description: The producer report apply-patch reads; ci-escalations: the checks the model escalated.

content-rule.description: What each changed file's bytes must also meet, after every refusal and allow rule passes and before any commit is built; a refusal escalates as protected-path. dependency-version-change: each file modified in place, a regular file, an npm or pip manifest or lock file in fix scope, changed only by a version (dependency-classify.mjs fixRefusal).

skip-moved-head.description: true: a PR head that moved since the producer's run skips superseded-sha, before the mint and again before the push; false: the patch takes the moved tip with --3way when the moved commits touch no patched path.

script-exec-bit.description: true: after every refusal passes, apply-patch makes each new or changed file that ends in .sh or starts with #! executable, since the model's tools set no file mode.

empty-at-push.description: The escalation kind for a patch that applies but changes nothing at push time: empty gives the row's empty reason, invalid its invalid reason (ci-context, since the producer said it wrote a change), conflict its unresolved-conflict reason (merge-base, where an empty patch leaves the conflicts as git left them).

escalations.description: The escalation reasons apply-patch may give for this row.
